get_entry.description: Get one entry of the compendium by its number or name, in Breath of the Wild or Tears of the Kingdom: its description, picture, where it is found and what it drops, and what applies to its kind, such as a weapon's attack and defence, a material's hearts and cooking effect, or a Tears of the Kingdom material's fuse power. A name typed any way is found; a name nobody has fails, suggesting the nearest.
get_entry.display_str_template: Get the entry {0} from the Hyrule Compendium.

entry.description: These fearsome monsters have lived in Hyrule since ancient times. Their ability to breathe fire makes White-Maned Lynels among the toughest of the species; each one of their attacks is an invitation to the grave. There are so few eyewitness accounts of this breed because a White-Maned Lynel is not one to let even simple passersby escape with their lives.
entry.name: white-maned lynel

get_entry.name: get_entry

parameters.description: The entry: its compendium number, such as 123, or its name, such as White-Maned Lynel or Hylian Shield, typed any way. Part of a name works when only one entry has it. An entry from List entries can be given whole.
parameters.name: entry

parameters.description: Which game's compendium to read: Breath of the Wild or Tears of the Kingdom. Defaults to Breath of the Wild. Entry IDs differ between the two games.
parameters.name: game

entry.description: The entry, with null for every field its category lacks.

attack.description: For equipment, its attack power; 0 for shields and arrows. Null for anything but equipment.

common_locations.description: Where it is commonly found, e.g. 'Hyrule Field'. Empty when the compendium does not say.

cooking_effect.description: The special effect it gives a dish or elixir, e.g. 'stamina recovery' or 'cold resistance'. Null when it has none, or cannot be cooked.

defense.description: For equipment, its defence; 0 for anything but a shield. Null for anything but equipment.

description.description: The compendium's description of it, a short paragraph.

dlc.description: Whether it came with a DLC pack.

drops.description: What it drops when defeated, or holds when opened, e.g. 'lynel horn'. Empty when it drops nothing, or for equipment and materials, which drop nothing.

edible.description: For a creature, whether it can be eaten or cooked. Null for anything but a creature.

effect.description: In Tears of the Kingdom, a weapon's special effect, e.g. 'wind razor' or 'zonaite-powered'. Null when it has none, and for Breath of the Wild.

fuse_attack_power.description: In Tears of the Kingdom, the attack a material adds when fused to a weapon. Null for anything else.

game.description: The game it is from: 'botw' (Breath of the Wild) or 'totk' (Tears of the Kingdom).

hearts_recovered.description: How many hearts eating it raw recovers, e.g. 0.5 for an apple. Only materials and edible creatures have it; null otherwise.

id.description: Its compendium number in this game, e.g. 123. Get entry takes it. The same number is a different entry in the other game.

image.description: A link to its picture, a 280 by 280 pixel PNG, e.g. 'https://api.hyrule-compendium.com/v3/compendium/entry/lynel/image'.

name.description: Its name, in lower case as the API writes it, e.g. 'lynel'.

weapon_type.description: In Tears of the Kingdom, the kind of equipment: 'one-handed weapon', 'two-handed weapon', 'spear', 'bow', 'shield' or 'arrow'. Null for Breath of the Wild and anything but equipment.

get_master_mode_entry.description: Get one of the enemies only found in Breath of the Wild's Master Mode, such as the Golden Lynel or the Sky Octorok, by its number or name, with its description, picture and drops. There are five; List Master Mode entries lists them.
get_master_mode_entry.display_str_template: Get the Master Mode entry {0} from the Hyrule Compendium.

entry.description: With brutal strength and extreme resilience, this type of Lynel somehow surpasses Silver Lynels in sheer power. It is said they are actually Silver Lynels who mysteriously transformed after being struck by lightning. If you see one, get away as fast as you can.
entry.name: golden lynel

entries.description: A Lynel-made bow crafted from rough metal. True to the vicious nature of Lynel weaponry, it fires a spread of multiple arrows at once. Ideal for taking down quick-moving targets.
entries.name: lynel bow

entries.description: A sturdy shield favored by Lynels for its defensive and offensive capabilities. First and foremost a shield, but the bladed edges can deal slashing attacks when deflecting.

entries.description: These low-level, octopus-like monsters used to be aquatic, but their inflatable air sacs evolved so that they are able to float around in the air. Other monsters are known to take advantage of this ability, using them to make floating fortresses. They are trained to ascend when they hear a whistle but they will not attack.
entries.name: sky octorok

entries.description: With brutal strength and extreme resilience, this type of Bokoblin somehow surpasses Silver Bokoblins in sheer power. It is said they are actually Silver Bokoblins who mysteriously transformed after being struck by lightning. Perhaps that is why they have such a high tolerance for electric attacks.
entries.name: golden bokoblin

entries.description: With brutal strength and extreme resilience, this type of Moblin somehow surpasses Silver Moblins in sheer power. description: Look up the in-game compendium of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom through the Hyrule Compendium API, a free community project: every creature, piece of equipment, material, monster and treasure, 389 entries in one game and 509 in the other, each with its description, picture, where it is found, what it drops, a weapon's attack and defence, a material's hearts, cooking effect and fuse power, and whether it came with a DLC pack. Get an entry by number or name, list and filter the compendium, pick an entry at random, read the enemies only found in Master Mode, and browse the regions of Hyrule with their shrines and settlements. No API key needed.
